_scoring.method: blind list saved to /Users/troded/.claude/jobs/c1df60cb/tmp/blind_B_20261121.txt before opening data/duties|powers; records filtered by matter_id from data/duties/{Y}.json and data/powers/{Y}.json; class rules run over all 9 sessions (33,813 records, 2009-2025)

_classes.name: extends_existing false on added list items/classes of an existing amended duty (siblings in same law flagged true)
_classes.rule: group records by (matter_id, agency, kind); in groups where any record has extends_existing true, match records with extends_existing false whose quote ends in ';' or ':' or starts lowercase
_classes.note: broad candidate rule; some matches are genuinely new items in mixed laws

_classes.name: raised cap on a local power stored extends_existing false (Kind ruling Nov 12)
_classes.rule: kind=='power' and not extends_existing and re.search(r'may (extend|increase|raise) the (maximum|number|limit)|for up to an additional', quote, re.I)
_classes.note: 2009-A7967-05/2017-A9814-05 are contract-term extension powers and may be wholly new; review

_classes.name: co-chair sentence split onto a co-actor whose name is reprinted unchanged text
_classes.rule: records whose identical (matter_id, quote) carries >=2 agencies and quote matches r'chaired by|co-?chair'; then test whether actor_raw sits outside {{ }} in the packet text

_classes.name: government cost-recovery limit (cap) stored as a power
_classes.rule: re.search(r'\bshall only recover\b|\bshall recover only\b|\bshall only (charge|collect|retain)\b', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: private party's submission-content list item stored as a government duty
content specification of a database/report stored as its own record with the deliverable as actor
one-time appointment setup duty with deadline none (criterion 5 wants on_effective_date)
_classes.rule: deliverable_type=='designation or staffing' and recurrence=='one-time' and deadline_kind=='none' and 'appoint' in quote+actor_raw

_classes.name: protocol sub-items not inheriting the act's stated development date
_classes.rule: in a (matter_id, agency, kind) group holding a fixed_date record whose quote names protocols/procedures/plan, flag plan-or-strategy records with deadline_kind none/on_effective_date

_classes.name: junk agency built from a descriptive actor phrase
sub_item_of_parent drop removing a distinct power
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='sub_item_of_parent' and re.search(r'\b(may|is authorized|is empowered)\b', quote) (case-sensitive: pre-2017 texts carry capitalised 'May' as a token, which the case-insensitive version wrongly matched in 2013-S7232-09)
_classes.note: 2013-S7232-05 itself is missed by the regex because its 'May' is capitalised in the pre-2017 text; affected laws 2013-S7232

_classes.name: same-as-chapter section date left unresolved
_classes.rule: effective_dates rule or any section_dates rule == 'same_as_chapter_unresolved'
_classes.note: law-level count; referenced bill 2017-S3789 absent from data/chapter_index.json
